claims.claim: Constellium's Q2 2026 segment adjusted EBITDA reached a company quarterly record, with A&T and P&ARP each at record quarterly segment EBITDA; management cited improved aerospace/TID conditions, North American automotive rolled-product shortages and recycling performance as contributors.

risks.risk: Some current uplift reflects favorable metal dynamics and supply shortages that may normalize.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of current scrap spreads and North American automotive rolled-product shortages beyond 2026 is unknown.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue rose 31% year over year to about $2.7B, net income rose to $148M, free cash flow was $90M and leverage fell to 1.8x; management raised 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $980M-$1.020B excluding metal-price lag and free-cash-flow guidance to above $300M, saying the 2028 targets are now expected two years early.

risks.risk: Reported adjusted EBITDA included a $129M positive non-cash metal-price-lag impact, so headline EBITDA is not a clean measure of underlying execution.

unknowns.unknown: No post-Q2 issuer financial update was located in this bounded Scout pass.
